purpose: Startup snapshot of the amended endgame run; not a training result or strength evidence.

starts.note: First amended start, child of the agent session.

Operator restart via STOP to detach from the agent session (nohup, parent launchd) plus caffeinate -i tied to the supervisor; same config and deadline. The STOP was renamed a few seconds before the supervisor wrote its final status, so that stop is labelled children-finished; the renamed STOP file keeps the real reason.

resources.machine: MacBook Pro M1 Pro, 10 cores, 32 GiB

evaluatorSanity.seeds: 30 development deals 3,838,150,000..029 from the smoke block (not held-out)

sameModel.expected: exactly 0: identical games with sides swapped

earlyStudent.note: Plumbing check only; 30 deals cannot measure strength.

postRun: A detached job waits for the supervisor to exit, then evaluates the final exported student on the 3,000 preregistered held-out deals (8 workers) into the run directory eval-final/.
